svg.text: BusCraft prototype: Pico W straight to the IEEE-488 connector (bottom view, solder side)
No bus driver chips. Wires run on the underside; the drawing shows pad to pad. Mirrored: this is how the board looks when you solder.
J1 IEEE-488 plug (5552221-1), overhangs the edge
Pico W (KA-0076), underside, USB to the right
GPIB 12 (shield): leave open or to GND.
Management EOI, ATN, IFC, SRQ, REN
J1 pin numbering is drawn as row A = 1-12,
row B = 13-24, pins 1 and 13 at the right.
Ground pins 18-24 and shield pin 12 are at
the same end: confirm by continuity.
